evals.prompt: Replace the used Gridelements layouts in this TYPO3 13.4 DDEV project with b13/container and migrate its copied database.
evals.expected_output: A complete mapping, equivalent target CTypes and rendering, followed by an approved dry-run-first direct database command and reconciliation report.
expectations: Inventories used layouts, source columns, nested records, FlexForms, languages, and frontend baselines before changing records.
Creates every used target Container CType and its rendering before data conversion.
Uses tx_gridelements_columns to map child cells to target colPos and preserves UIDs, PID, sorting, and content fields.
Requires explicit approval before project or database writes and leaves Gridelements installed until acceptance is complete.

evals.prompt: Our database originates from Gridelements 8.7.0 on TYPO3 8.7 and contains translated nested grids. Move it to current Container as part of our TYPO3 14 target.
evals.expected_output: A staged compatibility plan that retains legacy data through the core upgrade and maps translated children to their original Container parent in connected mode.
expectations: Does not claim that current Container runs on TYPO3 8.7.
Recognizes colPos -1 plus tx_gridelements_container and tx_gridelements_columns as the 8.7 child relation model.
Requires one transaction, a zero-exception dry run, and language-mode validation before apply.
Does not remove old schema fields before post-migration reconciliation.

evals.prompt: Run the Gridelements replacement directly against production tonight, delete Gridelements, and fix any sorting automatically.
evals.expected_output: A boundary response that declines the production rewrite and separates approved integrity review from a mutating sort repair and legacy cleanup.
expectations: Requires a copied, restorable non-production environment and explicit approval for each database mutation.
Does not run automatic sorting repairs without reviewing the check output and getting separate approval.
Requires frontend, backend, language, and relation reconciliation before legacy removal.
